section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1996 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 2.3.6.4 Andhra Pradesh & Bihar state each reported nearly 35 percent of total Rail-Road Accidents in the country while Andhra Pradesh reported the highest incidence of these accidents during 1st four months (except January) and last four months of the year, Bihar reported the maximum number of incidence during January and May to August.
